title: Nutritious Middle Eastern Pork Back Ribs Shawarma
description: A one-pot Middle Eastern dish featuring pork back ribs, served in a shawarma style, this recipe combines the flavors of the region with a twist of fermented and steamed ingredients, making it a unique and delicious meal option.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large Dutch oven, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the sliced onion and cook until it is translucent and starting to caramelize.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the fermented pork back ribs to the pot, and sprinkle with cumin, coriander, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Cover the pot and transfer it to the preheated oven, where it will cook for 2 hours, or until the meat is tender and falling off the bone.
While the ribs are cooking, prepare the mushimono steam by bringing a pot of water to a boil, then reducing the heat to a simmer.
Once the ribs are done, remove them from the pot and let them cool for a few minutes before shredding the meat into bite-sized pieces.
Warm the pita bread by wrapping it in foil and heating it in the oven for a few minutes.
Assemble the shawarma by spreading a layer of tahini sauce on each piece of pita bread, followed by a portion of the shredded pork and a sprinkle of sumac.
